business_problem: Veradigm is a top provider of healthcare data and tech solutions for payers, providers, and life sciences—including billing services via its Practice Fusion EHR platform. It was fielding high volumes of basic medical billing questions. To help customers get faster answers, Veradigm used Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI Service, and more in a Zammo.ai software solution to develop Billerbot. The generative AI–powered self-help chatbot is programmed to field basic queries about medical terms, processes, and billing.
